paragraphs: Here's what sticks with me, friend. Pharaoh saw a staff swallow up every other staff, and he saw a whole river turn to blood. Both times, "Pharaoh's heart was hardened, and he would not listen" (Exodus 7:13, 22). The signs were not the problem, because a heart that has made up its mind can watch anything and still say, "Eh."

Notice that the LORD told Moses and Aaron what was coming before it happened. They threw the staff down and struck the water "just as the LORD had commanded" (Exodus 7:20). They didn't have to be the strongest or the most impressive, because the LORD was the One running the plan. And when the magicians matched the serpents, it didn't change a thing, since Aaron's staff swallowed up the other staffs (Exodus 7:12).

So here's what it means for you, baker. When God speaks, the best thing you can do is listen and do what He says, even when it feels too small to matter. The LORD said the whole point was "By this you will know that I am the LORD" (Exodus 7:17). Keep your heart soft like fresh dough, friend, because the God who sends the signs is worth listening to.
